literal: Suzong, Emperor Xiaoming, bore the taboo name Xu; he was Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu's second son; his mother was Hu Chuhua.
idiomatic: Suzong, Emperor Xiaoming, bore the taboo name Xu. He was Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu's second son; his mother was Hu Chuhua.

literal: In the third year of Yongping, third month, day bingxu, the Emperor was born northeast of the Xuanguang Hall; light shone in the courtyard.
idiomatic: In the third year of Yongping, in the third month, on the bingxu day, the emperor was born northeast of the Xuanguang Hall; light shone in the courtyard.

literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Yanchang, day yihai, he was installed as crown prince.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Yanchang, on the yihai day, he was installed as crown prince.

literal: In the fourth year, first month of spring, on the night of day dingsi, he took the imperial throne.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the first month of spring, on the night of the dingsi day, he took the imperial throne.

literal: Day wuwu: a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Day jiwei: the armies of the western campaign and eastern defense were recalled.
idiomatic: On the jiwei day the armies of the western campaign and eastern defense were recalled.

literal: Day gengshen: an edict ordered Grand Guardian, Prince of Gaoyang Yong to enter the Western Cypress Hall and decide routine government; it also ordered Prince of Rencheng Cheng to be Minister Director and all officials to entrust themselves to the two princes.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day an edict ordered Yong, grand guardian and Prince of Gaoyang, to enter the Western Cypress Hall and decide routine government; it also ordered Cheng, Prince of Rencheng, to be minister director, and all officials to entrust themselves to the two princes.

literal: Day jisi: Wuji, Dapan, Didouhe, Nibujia, Baidan, Zuoyue Feishi, and other states sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the jisi day Wuji, Dapan, Didouhe, Nibujia, Baidan, Zuoyue Feishi, and other states sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Second month, day gengchen: the empress of the Gao clan was honored as empress dowager.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengchen day, the empress of the Gao clan was honored as empress dowager.

literal: Day xinsi: Minister over the Masses Gao Zhao arrived at the capital and was ordered to die for his crime.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day Gao Zhao, minister over the masses, arrived at the capital and was ordered to die for his crime.

literal: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Ningzhou Ren Taihong led a host to raid Guancheng; Chief Clerk of Yizhou Cheng Xingsun defeated him.
idiomatic: Ren Taihong, Xiao Yan's inspector of Ningzhou, led a host to raid Guancheng; Cheng Xingsun, chief clerk of Yizhou, defeated him.

literal: Day guiwei: Grand Guardian, Prince of Gaoyang Yong was promoted to Grand Tutor and held additionally the post of Grand Minister; Minister of Works, Prince of Qinghe Yi was made Minister over the Masses; Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Guangping Huai was made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day Yong, grand guardian and Prince of Gaoyang, was promoted to grand tutor and held additionally the post of grand minister; Yi, minister of works and Prince of Qinghe, was made minister over the masses; Huai, grand general of agile cavalry and Prince of Guanghe, was made minister of works.

literal: Day jihai: Hu Chuhua was honored as imperial noble consort.
idiomatic: On the jihai day Hu Chuhua was honored as imperial noble consort.

literal: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Third month, day jiachen, new moon: the empress dowager left the laity and became a nun, moving her residence to the Jintong quarter.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiachen day, the new moon, the empress dowager left the laity and became a nun, moving her residence to the Jintong quarter.

literal: Day bingchen: an edict ordered palace officials promoted one rank.
idiomatic: On the bingchen day an edict ordered palace officials promoted one rank.

literal: Earlier, Xiao Yan had dammed the Huai at Fushan, intending harm to Yang and Xu; an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the South Yang Dayan to attack him.
idiomatic: Earlier Xiao Yan had dammed the Huai at Fushan, intending harm to Yang and Xu; an edict ordered Yang Dayan, general who pacifies the south, to attack him.

literal: Day yichou: civil and military officials were promoted one rank.
idiomatic: On the yichou day civil and military officials were promoted one rank.

literal: Fourth month of summer: Inspector of Liangzhou Xue Huaigu defeated rebellious Di at the Ju River.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Xue Huaigu, inspector of Liangzhou, defeated rebellious Di at the Ju River.

literal: Fifth month, day jiayin: Inspector of South Qinzhou Cui Xian defeated Di bandits and lifted the siege of Wuxing.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiayin day, Cui Xian, inspector of South Qinzhou, defeated Di bandits and lifted the siege of Wuxing.

literal: Sixth month: the monk Fajing gathered a crowd and rebelled in Jizhou, killed the magistrate of Fucheng, and styled himself Mahayana.
idiomatic: In the sixth month the monk Fajing gathered a crowd and rebelled in Jizhou, killed the magistrate of Fucheng, and styled himself Mahayana.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day guimao: Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guimao day, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day dingwei: an edict made Acting Right Honorable Grand Master Yuan Yao General Who Campaigns North and attack Fajing.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day an edict made Yuan Yao, acting right honorable grand master, general who campaigns north to attack Fajing.

literal: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Eighth month, day yihai: Director of the Palace Guard Yu Zhong forged an edict and killed Left Vice Director Guo Zuo and Minister Pei Zhi; he removed Grand Tutor, Grand Minister, Prince of Gaoyang Yong from office and sent the prince home.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yihai day, Yu Zhong, director of the palace guard, forged an edict and killed Guo Zuo, left vice director, and Pei Zhi, minister; he removed Yong, grand tutor, grand minister, and Prince of Gaoyang, from office and sent the prince home.

literal: Day bingzi: the imperial noble consort was honored as empress dowager.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day the imperial noble consort was honored as empress dowager.

literal: Day jimao: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the jimao day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day gengchen: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Dingzhou Tian Chaoqiu led three thousand men to request surrender.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day Tian Chaoqiu, Xiao Yan's inspector of Dingzhou, led three thousand men to request surrender.

literal: Day wuzi: the emperor attended upon the empress dowager at the Xuanguang Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day the emperor attended upon the empress dowager at the Xuanguang Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

literal: Day jichou: Minister over the Masses, Prince of Qinghe Yi was promoted to Grand Tutor and held additionally the post of Grand Minister;
idiomatic: On the jichou day Yi, minister over the masses and Prince of Qinghe, was promoted to grand tutor and held additionally the post of grand minister;

literal: Minister of Works, Prince of Guangping Huai was made Grand Guardian and held additionally the post of Minister over the Masses;
idiomatic: Huai, minister of works and Prince of Guangping, was made grand guardian and held additionally the post of minister over the masses;

literal: Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Rencheng Cheng was made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: Cheng, grand general of agile cavalry and Prince of Rencheng, was made minister of works.

literal: Day gengyin: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry Yu Zhong was made Minister Director; Special Advanced Cui Guang was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry; both held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day Yu Zhong was made minister director; Cui Guang, special advanced, was made grand general of chariots and cavalry; both held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

literal: Day renchen: the former Prince of Jiangyang Ji was restored to his original state;
idiomatic: On the renchen day the former Prince of Jiangyang Ji was restored to his original state;

literal: Prince of Jinan Yu was restored to his former enfeoffment as Prince of Linhuai.
idiomatic: Yu, Prince of Jinan, was restored to his former enfeoffment as Prince of Linhuai.

literal: The ministers memorialized requesting that the empress dowager hold court and exercise regency.
idiomatic: The ministers memorialized requesting that the empress dowager hold court and exercise regency.

literal: Ninth month, day yisi: the empress dowager personally handled affairs of state; an edict said, "Gaozu reformed rites and completed governance; his lingering bounty rests on the people.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yisi day, the empress dowager personally handled affairs of state; an edict said, "Gaozu reformed rites and completed governance; his lingering bounty rests on the people.

literal: Shizong succeeded the great enterprise; his sage virtue shone far.
idiomatic: Shizong succeeded the great enterprise; his sage virtue shone far.

literal: We, being young and tender, have been set upon the imperial chart; the great foundation is weighty indeed, as if treading on thin ice.
idiomatic: We, being young and tender, have been set upon the imperial chart; the great foundation is weighty indeed, as if treading on thin ice.

literal: Kings, dukes, the hundred ministers, provincial governors, and all officials have all received favor from the former court; glory and honor are of old—each should strive to exalt virtue, together to secure the age, and with united strength and utmost loyalty assist where we fall short.
idiomatic: Kings, dukes, the hundred ministers, provincial governors, and all officials have all received favor from the former court; glory and honor are of old—each should strive to exalt virtue, together to secure the age, and with united strength and utmost loyalty assist where we fall short.

literal: Those who cherish the Way in garden and grove, hide their tracks at the pounding frame, dwell in mountains and drink in valleys, and unfold or withdraw as the times require should be given ample silks to harmonize the tripod's stew.
idiomatic: Those who cherish the Way in garden and grove, hide their tracks at the pounding frame, dwell in mountains and drink in valleys, and unfold or withdraw as the times require should be given ample silks to harmonize the tripod's stew.

literal: Those able to offer forthright counsel and benefit the age should be reported from their districts and will be appointed to extraordinary rank.
idiomatic: Those able to offer forthright counsel and benefit the age should be reported from their districts and will be appointed to extraordinary rank.

literal: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives should have their gates marked to display their excellence.
idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives should have their gates marked to display their excellence.

literal: The aged and solitary who cannot support themselves should be provided grain and cloth.
idiomatic: The aged and solitary who cannot support themselves should be provided grain and cloth.

literal: If because of famine they lost their livelihood and kin were scattered, or if men and women were sold as slaves, each may be allowed to return.
idiomatic: If because of famine they lost their livelihood and kin were scattered, or if men and women were sold as slaves, each may be allowed to return.

literal: Recently the Ji region was not yet pacified and Xucheng suffered raids; the commanders have long been toiling and the soldiers weary—envoys should be sent to comfort them and grant clothing and horses.
idiomatic: Recently the Ji region was not yet pacified and Xucheng suffered raids; the commanders have long been toiling and the soldiers weary—envoys should be sent to comfort them and grant clothing and horses.

literal: Border provinces and garrisons bear the labor of solid defense; chiefs and people of the northern frontier are entrusted to the north—let them also be rewarded with labor gifts to satisfy their hearts.
idiomatic: Border provinces and garrisons bear the labor of solid defense; chiefs and people of the northern frontier are entrusted to the north—let them also be rewarded with labor gifts to satisfy their hearts.

literal: Where former-court matters have lain dormant and recent custom does not follow the standard pattern, all may be reported in summary for our review.
idiomatic: Where former-court matters have lain dormant and recent custom does not follow the standard pattern, all may be reported in summary for our review.

literal: If something benefits the age and governance and is not bound by regular statutes, it shall follow a separate precedent.
idiomatic: If something benefits the age and governance and is not bound by regular statutes, it shall follow a separate precedent.

literal: Make this clearly understood and in accord with our intent."
idiomatic: Make this clearly understood and in accord with our intent."

literal: Day jiayin: Campaign North Yuan Yao defeated and beheaded Fajing and more than a hundred chieftains; their heads were sent to the capital.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day Yuan Yao, who campaigns north, defeated and beheaded Fajing and more than a hundred chieftains; their heads were sent to the capital.

literal: Prince of Anding Ye died.
idiomatic: Ye, Prince of Anding, died.

literal: Day gengshen: Gaochang, Kumo Xi, and Khitan all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day Gaochang, Kumo Xi, and Khitan all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Xiao Yan's general Zhao Zuyue seized and held Xiashi by surprise.
idiomatic: Xiao Yan's general Zhao Zuyue seized and held Xiashi by surprise.

literal: Day guihai: an edict made Inspector of Dingzhou Cui Liang acting General Who Pacifies the South and lead the generals to attack;
idiomatic: On the guihai day an edict made Cui Liang, inspector of Dingzhou, acting general who pacifies the south and lead the generals to attack;

literal: Inspector of Jizhou Xiao Baoyin was made General Who Pacifies the East and encamped at the Huai dam.
idiomatic: Xiao Baoyin, inspector of Jizhou, was made general who pacifies the east and encamped at the Huai dam.

literal: Day wuchen: Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day gengwu, new moon: Wuji presented tribute arrows.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengwu day, the new moon, Wuji presented tribute arrows.

literal: Day renwu: Goryeo and Tuyuhun both sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the renwu day Goryeo and Tuyuhun both sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day yiyou: Duke of Anding Hu Guozhen was made Director of the Secretariat and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day Hu Guozhen, Duke of Anding, was made director of the secretariat and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

literal: Day jiawu: Xiao Yan's Administrator of Honghua Du Gui surrendered his commandery inward.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day Du Gui, Xiao Yan's administrator of Honghua, surrendered his commandery inward.

literal: Twelfth month, day xinchou: Prince of Gaoyang Yong was made Grand Preceptor.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinchou day, Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, was made grand preceptor.

literal: Day jiyou: Cui Liang, who pacifies the south, defeated Zuyue and then besieged Xiashi.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day Cui Liang, who pacifies the south, defeated Zuyue and then besieged Xiashi.

literal: Day dingmao: the emperor and empress dowager visited Jingling.
idiomatic: On the dingmao day the emperor and empress dowager visited Jingling.

literal: The Gaoche state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The Gaoche state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: First month of spring in the first year of Xiping, day wuchen, new moon: a general amnesty; the reign title was changed.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Xiping, on the wuchen day, the new moon, a general amnesty was proclaimed; the reign title was changed.

literal: Area Commander of Jing and Mian Yuan Zhi greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army and beheaded his Administrator of Hengnong Wang Shiding and others.
idiomatic: Yuan Zhi, area commander of Jing and Mian, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army and beheaded Wang Shiding, his administrator of Hengnong, and others.

literal: Minister of Personnel Li Ping was made General Who Pacifies the Army and concurrently Right Vice Director; he was made Mobile Headquarters to direct the armies attacking Xiashi.
idiomatic: Li Ping, minister of personnel, was made general who pacifies the army and concurrently right vice director; he was made mobile headquarters to direct the armies attacking Xiashi.

literal: Second month, day yisi: Xiao Baoyin, who pacifies the east, greatly defeated Yan's generals north of the Huai.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the yisi day, Xiao Baoyin, who pacifies the east, greatly defeated Yan's generals north of the Huai.

literal: Day guihai: for the first time licentiates were examined by policy essays; those ranked middle upper and above were given office.
idiomatic: On the guihai day, for the first time licentiates were examined by policy essays; those ranked middle upper and above were given office.

literal: Day yichou: Cui Liang, who pacifies the south, Li Ping, who pacifies the army, and others took Xiashi, beheaded Xiao Yan's Inspector of Yuzhou Zhao Zuyue, sent his head to the capital, and captured all his followers.
idiomatic: On the yichou day Cui Liang, who pacifies the south, Li Ping, who pacifies the army, and others took Xiashi, beheaded Zhao Zuyue, Xiao Yan's inspector of Yuzhou, sent his head to the capital, and captured all his followers.

literal: That month Tuyuhun, Dangchang, and Dengzhi all sent tribute.
idiomatic: That month Tuyuhun, Dangchang, and Dengzhi all sent tribute.

literal: Third month, day xinwei: Inspector of Yangzhou Li Chong was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinwei day, Li Chong, inspector of Yangzhou, was made grand general of agile cavalry and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

literal: Day renchen: captives from Xiashi were distributed among the hundred officials.
idiomatic: On the renchen day captives from Xiashi were distributed among the hundred officials.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day wuxu: because the people of Yingzhou were famished, granaries were opened to relieve them.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuxu day, because the people of Yingzhou were famished, granaries were opened to relieve them.

literal: Gaochang and Yinping both sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Gaochang and Yinping both sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fifth month, day dingmao, new moon: an edict said, "Heat and drought have lasted many days; the crops wither; though there has been slight rain, it has not yet soaked through; late plantings are not in; we look up in anxious toil—the blame rests on us, and we think to discipline ourselves.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingmao day, the new moon, an edict said, "Heat and drought have lasted many days; the crops wither; though there has been slight rain, it has not yet soaked through; late plantings are not in; we look up in anxious toil—the blame rests on us, and we think to discipline ourselves.

literal: The Secretariat should examine and comfort those in prison, investigate wrongful detention, weigh severity and lightness, and report as matters arise, so that not one person groans in resentment and harmony is further harmed.
idiomatic: The Secretariat should examine and comfort those in prison, investigate wrongful detention, weigh severity and lightness, and report as matters arise, so that not one person groans in resentment and harmony is further harmed.

literal: Earth and timber projects are for the time all halted; encourage farming and reduce affairs; exert strength in the fields.
idiomatic: Earth and timber projects are for the time all halted; encourage farming and reduce affairs; exert strength in the fields.

literal: May the good rains soon descend and an abundant year be assured."
idiomatic: May the good rains soon descend and an abundant year be assured."

literal: " Xiao Yan's Inspector of Hengzhou Zhang Qi raided Yizhou, [1] and Fu Shuyan was again made inspector to attack him; he repeatedly defeated the rebel armies and beheaded their general Ren Taihong.
idiomatic: " Xiao Yan's inspector of Hengzhou Zhang Qi raided Yizhou, [1] and Fu Shuyan was again made inspector to attack him; he repeatedly defeated the rebel armies and beheaded their general Ren Taihong.

literal: Day gengwu: an edict released the wild beasts of Hualin Park to mountains and marshes.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day an edict released the wild beasts of Hualin Park to mountains and marshes.

literal: Day bingxu: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day gengwu: the prohibition on slaughtering cattle was reaffirmed.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengwu day, the prohibition on slaughtering cattle was reaffirmed.

literal: Day bingzi: an edict granted soldiers who had campaigned at Xiashi one year's remission of tax and corvée.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day an edict granted soldiers who had campaigned at Xiashi one year's remission of tax and corvée.

literal: Fu Shuyan greatly defeated Zhang Qi; Qi fled.
idiomatic: Fu Shuyan greatly defeated Zhang Qi; Qi fled.

literal: Day yiyou: Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Eighth month, day yisi: Attendant at the Secretariat, Director of the Secretariat, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies, Duke of Anding Commandery Hu Guozhen was made Area Commander of Yong, Jing, Qi, Hua, East Qin, and Bin—six provinces—Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Commissioner with the Golden Axe, and Inspector of Yongzhou.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yisi day, Hu Guozhen, attendant at the secretariat, director of the secretariat, equal in rank with the three excellencies, and Duke of Anding commandery, was made area commander of Yong, Jing, Qi, Hua, East Qin, and Bin—six provinces—grand general of agile cavalry, commissioner with the golden axe, and inspector of Yongzhou.

literal: Day bingwu: an edict said, "Former sages and successive holy ones— their Way crowns living men; benevolent winds and flourishing virtue shine in the histories.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day an edict said, "Former sages and successive holy ones—their Way crowns living men; benevolent winds and flourishing virtue shine in the histories.

literal: When the mandate's term ended forever, traces followed things in change; tombs piled in mist, turned to rank grass; ancient emperors' mausolea were often trampled.
idiomatic: When the mandate's term ended forever, traces followed things in change; tombs piled in mist, turned to rank grass; ancient emperors' mausolea were often trampled.

literal: Let it be clearly ordered in every place that for all imperial tombs, within fifty paces on each side, farming is not permitted."
idiomatic: Let it be clearly ordered in every place that for all imperial tombs, within fifty paces on each side, farming is not permitted."

literal: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Ninth month, day dingchou: the Huai dam broke; more than a hundred thousand mouths in Xiao Yan's garrison towns and villages along the Huai were all swept into the sea.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingchou day, the Huai dam broke; more than a hundred thousand mouths in Xiao Yan's garrison towns and villages along the Huai were all swept into the sea.

literal: Twelfth month, day guisi: an edict ordered that in Luoyang, Heyin, and among miscellaneous persons of various offices—those seventy and above, widowers and widows in poverty unable to support themselves, and though young yet chronically ill and long disabled or destitute and unable to get by—should be investigated in truth and listed in full for report.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guisi day, an edict ordered that in Luoyang, Heyin, and among miscellaneous persons of various offices—those seventy and above, widowers and widows in poverty unable to support themselves, and though young yet chronically ill and long disabled or destitute and unable to get by—should be investigated in truth and listed in full for report.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day jiawu: Goryeo, Persia, Shule, and Yanda all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiawu day, Goryeo, Persia, Shule, and Yanda all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day dingyou: an edict ordered that within the capital prefect's jurisdiction, those a hundred and above were granted a great commandery staff, those ninety and above a small commandery staff.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day an edict ordered that within the capital prefect's jurisdiction, those a hundred and above were granted a great commandery staff, those ninety and above a small commandery staff.

literal: Day wushen: Director of the Secretariat, Commissioner with the Golden Axe Hu Guozhen was made Minister of Works; Special Advanced, Prince of Runan Yue was made Director of the Secretariat and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On the wushen day Hu Guozhen, director of the secretariat and commissioner with the golden axe, was made minister of works; Yue, special advanced and Prince of Runan, was made director of the secretariat and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

literal: Day yimao: the empress dowager visited the Yique cave temple and returned to the palace the same day.
idiomatic: On the yimao day the empress dowager visited the Yique cave temple and returned to the palace the same day.

literal: Prince of Anding Chao was enfeoffed afresh as Prince of Beiping.
idiomatic: Chao, Prince of Anding, was enfeoffed afresh as Prince of Beiping.

literal: Fifth month, day xinyou: an edict said, "For soldiers killed in battle at Yangzhou's Xiashi, Jingshan, Xinhuai, and Zuo city, burial goods are granted posthumously and one household is granted five years' tax remission;
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinyou day, an edict said, "For soldiers killed in battle at Yangzhou's Xiashi, Jingshan, Xinhuai, and Zuo city, burial goods are granted posthumously and one household is granted five years' tax remission;
